description: This file defines React components for a context menu UI, leveraging Radix UI primitives and lucide-react icons, with utility functions for styling and composition.

methods.name: ContextMenu
methods.description: Root component for the context menu, wraps the Radix UI Root primitive.

methods.name: ContextMenuTrigger
methods.description: Component for the element that triggers the context menu, wraps Radix UI Trigger primitive.

methods.name: ContextMenuGroup
methods.description: Component to group menu items, wraps Radix UI Group primitive.

methods.name: ContextMenuPortal
methods.description: Component to render menu content in a React portal, wraps Radix UI Portal primitive.

methods.name: ContextMenuSub
methods.description: Component for submenu support, wraps Radix UI Sub primitive.

methods.name: ContextMenuRadioGroup
methods.description: Component for radio button groups within the menu, wraps Radix UI RadioGroup primitive.

methods.name: ContextMenuSubTrigger
methods.description: Component for submenu trigger with optional inset styling.

methods.name: ContextMenuSubContent
methods.description: Component for displaying submenu content with animation and styling.

methods.name: ContextMenuContent
methods.description: Main container for menu items, rendered via portal with animation styles.

methods.name: ContextMenuItem
methods.description: Component representing a menu item, with support for variants and inset styling.

methods.name: ContextMenuCheckboxItem
methods.description: Menu item component with checkbox support, indicating checked state.

methods.name: ContextMenuRadioItem
methods.description: Menu item component with radio support, indicating selection.

methods.name: ContextMenuLabel
methods.description: Label for grouping items within the menu, supports inset styling.

methods.name: ContextMenuShortcut
methods.description: Displays shortcut hints for menu items.
